subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: Should the final Matrix QA ownership stack retire the source-only qa-matrix package now, after the predecessor stack lands and the exact-head dependency removal is authorized?
rationale: Automation can verify the implementation and proof, but it cannot choose the compatibility-retirement timing, approve the protected maintainer PR, or authorize the intentional package and lockfile graph removal.

options.title: Land the ordered stack
options.body: Merge the predecessors first, review the final combined result, authorize the exact-head dependency removal, and accept retirement of the temporary source-only package.

options.title: Keep one compatibility window
options.body: Retain the qa-matrix package temporarily and add an explicit removal point if maintainers believe direct source-checkout consumers still need a transition period.

options.title: Pause the cleanup
options.body: Leave this PR open or close the stack if the predecessor ownership migration will not land or the compatibility retirement is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Land the ordered stack
recommendation.body: Merge the predecessors first, review the final combined result, authorize the exact-head dependency removal, and accept retirement of the temporary source-only package.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa owns the current Matrix QA consolidation stack and is best positioned to confirm ordering and coordinate the required authorization.
